concept.shortdesc: Large enterprises such as IBM publish their own corporatewide style guides, such as the IBM

conbody.p:
Large enterprises such as IBM publish their own corporatewide style guides, such as the IBM Style for externalfacing content. This guide is used across software, cloud, AI, and systemslevel documentation, and focuses on:
Consistent terminology, capitalization, and sentence structure for technical, marketingfacing, and customersupport content.
Rules for digital help, online manuals, and marketingadjacent documentation so that the same brand voice and terminology run through all customertouching content.
IBMstyle documentation tends to be more formal and enterpriseoriented than some developerfirst guides. It still emphasizes clarity and usability for diverse audiences.
